# `small-case`

End-to-end acquisition fixture (plan Sections 15, 17/P2.2). Like `path-edges`,
this directory tracks the fixture *definition*; the tree is generated by
`small_tree` in `crates/ghosttrace-core/tests/capture_recovery.rs` at test
time, because Git cannot track FIFOs and generated trees keep byte-identity
problems out of history.

## Generated shape

```
<evidence>/
├── report.txt              "ghosttrace\n"            (11 bytes)
├── nested/notes.md         "notes\n"                 (6 bytes)
├── nested/deep/payload.bin 4 bytes of 0x00..0x03
├── link.txt -> report.txt  symlink (captured, never followed)
└── pipe                    FIFO (recorded, never read)
```

## Expected acquisition

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| acquisition state | `completed` |
| published objects | 3 (one per regular file) |
| coverage captured | 4 (3 files + the link observation) |
| coverage unsupported | 1 (the FIFO) |
| manifest objects | 3, each verifying against the stored copy |
| capture metadata events | 5 (`file.observed`, application clock) |
| recovery leftovers | none |
| source bytes | unchanged by capture |
| second run of the same tree | 3 `deduplicated` copies, 3 stored files |
